openQuestions: N4X_SYSTEM_RELEASE_INDEX is empty in local compose; Host only compares an official index when that env is set.

notes.responsibility: Personal graph-native runtime. One operator per process. Anyone who can reach MCP can change the instance. Not multi-tenant SaaS and not a sandbox for untrusted code.
notes.local: scripts/local.sh starts Host + Neo4j on 127.0.0.1:7744. The image listens on 0.0.0.0 inside the container. Public self-host identity is the operator's job.
notes.image: deploy/Dockerfile copies Host, graph, secrets, source_store, kernel, contracts, and CLI. It does not copy backend/n4x/system. Official System zip is baked at /opt/n4x/cache/official-system.zip.
